items.title: PHP2Shell: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in PHP Core
items.summary: These critical vulnerabilities in the PHP core allow unauthenticated remote code execution on any server running a vulnerable version, including those hosting Magento/Adobe Commerce. Exploitation requires no authentication or user interaction, making mass exploitation highly probable.

items.title: BlockStrap: Template Engine Injection Remote Code Execution
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, dubbed BlockStrap, is a template engine injection flaw that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution on Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Adobe released a fix on October 13, 2026, but new installations may still require a manual patch.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Template Engine Injection Remote Code Execution (Exploited In-The-Wild)
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability, known as StyleSmuggler, allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations. Adobe released an emergency hotfix on September 7, 2026, and is aware of active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Multiple Stored Cross-site Scripting Vulnerabilities
items.summary: The September 2026 security update addresses several vulnerabilities, including two stored cross-site scripting (XSS) flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201) with a CVSS score of 9.3, exploitable without authentication. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated Incorrect Authorization Flaw
items.summary: Part of the September 2026 security update, this high-severity vulnerability is an unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw (CVSS 9.1). Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-153, is an incorrect authorization flaw that could lead to privilege escalation. Adobe released a security update on October 13, 2026, to resolve this issue.

items.title: Multiple Stored Cross-site Scripting Vulnerabilities
items.summary: APSB26-153 addresses several high-severity stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass. These issues were resolved in the October 13, 2026, security update.

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in. This vulnerability opens the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload via REST API
items.summary: PolyShell allows attackers to upload executable files to any Magento or Adobe Commerce store via the REST API. No official patch exists for this vulnerability, which was reported by Sansec.
